---
title: "Edit a dog's or owner's details"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-05 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Correct or update the details on file: the owner's name, phone number or
email, and the dog's name, breed, coat, sex or birthday.

## Applies to

Every groomer, whenever a detail on file is wrong or has changed, for
example when an owner gives a new phone number.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile.
- The dog's card is open. See [GRM-02 Check in a
  dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd), steps 2 to 4.

## Procedure

1. Click **Edit profile** at the top right of the dog's card. The **Edit**
   form opens with the dog's name, showing everything on file.

   ![The Edit profile form](/screenshots/groomer/edit-profile.png)

2. To change the owner's contact details, go to the **Owner** box:
   - Click **Phone**, delete the old number, and type the new one.
   - Click **Email**, delete the old address, and type the new one.
   - To correct the owner's name, click **First name** or **Last name** and
     type the correction.

3. To change the dog's details, go to the **Dog** box and change the field
   that is wrong. The fields work the same way as when the client was added.
   See [GRM-03 Add a new client](new-client.qmd), steps 5 to 9.

4. Click **Save changes**. The form closes and the dog's card shows the new
   details.

   To leave without changing anything, click **Cancel**.

::: {.callout-important}
## The owner's details are shared
If the owner has more than one dog, the form says **The owner's details are
shared with** the other dogs' names. A change to the owner's name, phone or
email shows on every one of their dogs' cards.
:::

## Result

The dog's card shows the corrected details. The system records each change,
what it was before and after, and who made it.

## If something goes wrong

### Save changes cannot be clicked

Nothing on the form has changed yet, or no coat is chosen. Change the detail
you meant to change, and make sure a button under **Coat** is selected.
